fields.FIR_Description: The reported incident took place on 2025-07-19 (morning, 11:35): A message about KYC expiry led the complainant to a website where account credentials were entered, and Rs. 12,000 was transferred out. The online submission was made by Nithin Balan (9000000470). The complainant alleged that Rajesh Karuppasamy may be involved and provided the mobile number 9000000318. Items referenced in the complaint: mobile phone records and social media screenshots.
fields.Evidence_Mentioned: Mobile phone record; Social media screenshot
fields.Modus_Operandi: Victim reported receiving a suspicious link that imitated a bank notification.
fields.Keywords: phishing, suspicious link, phone records, morning, screenshot, suspect, mobile number, apartment complex
